name: recallum-memory
description: Persistent, project-aware memory for Cursor through a self-hosted Recallum MCP server.

RECALLUM_MCP_URL.title: Recallum MCP endpoint
RECALLUM_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of your own Recallum server. Use HTTPS and the exact /mcp/ path; plain HTTP is allowed only on localhost or 127.0.0.1.

RECALLUM_API_KEY.title: Recallum API key
RECALLUM_API_KEY.description: API key for your Recallum server. Enter it in Cursor's plugin settings; never commit it.
